title: Standard manual capsulorhexis / Ultrasound phacoemulsification compared to femtosecond laser-assisted capsulorhexis and lens fragmentation in clear cornea small incision cataract surgery

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License, ext-link http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/; CC0 waiver for the data made available in the article)

indication: Age-related cataract (LOCS III grade 1-4) in 133 consecutive eyes, with or without astigmatism correction (toric IOL in 27/66 and 25/67 eyes); single surgeon

groups.description: Group A (Phaco): manual corneal incisions (2.75 mm superior clear cornea), manual capsulorhexis and ultrasound phacoemulsification (Constellation), AcrySof IQ (toric) IOL in the bag; randomized by randomization table; dexamethasone/tobramycin 4 weeks

Group B: femtosecond laser-assisted capsulotomy and in-situ lens fragmentation (LenSx, SoftFit interface) followed by phacoemulsification (Constellation), AcrySof IQ (toric) IOL in the bag; randomized; same surgeon and postoperative regimen

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of the operated eye (Table 2 Group-A row 'Average', column 'Pre-Op'); anterior-segment OCT pachymetry, RTVue-100, Optovue (Methods)
series.notes: Table 2 Group-A 'Average' row in µm (SD in the 'St Dev' row); columns Pre-Op, 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months. n_by_time from Results: all cases evaluated until 3 months, 60 eyes at 6 months.

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of the operated eye (Table 2 Group-B row 'Average', column 'Pre-Op'); anterior-segment OCT pachymetry, RTVue-100, Optovue (Methods)
series.notes: Table 2 Group-B 'Average' row in µm (SD in the 'St Dev' row); columns Pre-Op, 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months. n_by_time from Results: all cases evaluated until 3 months, 62 eyes at 6 months.

exclusions.reason: The same table gives absolute CCT; the absolute series are used

exclusions.what: Table 2 'p-value (paired test group-A to group-B)' row

exclusions.reason: Examined clinically but no 12-month CCT is tabulated

exclusions.what: Tables 1 and 3 (baseline/surgical data, endothelial cell density)

notes: Roles: femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery (LenSx) is the technique evaluated against standard manual capsulorhexis and ultrasound phacoemulsification; allocation by randomization table. FLACS is treated, manual phaco is control; both are cataract context.
Data were collected by optometry staff during routine visits without knowledge of the later analysis (Methods).
